id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|599: My storehouse can hold no more wealth; its light fills the night sky. I order the villagers to move the treasure.
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|5ad: The treasure box and scarlet gem lie past Mount Huji's back path, overlooking the god of fire.
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|5d0: ~Chapter 1: The Dream Begins~ I'm Ittetsu, a blacksmith, age 48. My favorite food is horse mackerel namerou.
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|5dd: Today I found something amazing at the bathhouse. A plain gold coin, but its fine star design is no ordinary work.
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|5ed: My blacksmith's soul trembled; I couldn't sit still. I hear it's called a mini medal.
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|5f9: I've decided to leave my hometown and set out on a journey to learn how to make mini medals.
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|606: Oh, don't stop me, Mother. I'll become the world's best blacksmith and return to this village someday...
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|61f: It's a picture book called "The Adventures of Miko and Ryu."
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|622: Miko and Ryu ruled Hotto. They were father and son, and so strong that monsters fled from them.
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|62d: The two who ruled Hotto defeated the monsters that came from outside and protected the villagers.
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|638: But the two had a fated enemy: a man-eating fire dragon that had long lived on Mount Huji and attacked Hotto.
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|646: One day, after a long battle, the two defeated the man-eating fire dragon. But then Ryu was struck by the dragon's fang...
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|653: Ryu never returned, but his name is still told in Hotto to this day.
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|668: It's a biography called "Pink Afterimage: Proving the Legend of Alice."
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|671: Born to a poor farming family, through character and strength alone, they rose to naval officer of the Bandelfon Kingdom...
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|67e: With their beloved king dead, they turned pirate. Love and Justice's Pink Mask thrilled the world.
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|68f: With a traveling entertainer, they dyed the masts of countless ships pink, in mourning for the king.
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|6a0: That pink-dyed sea still burns in our hearts today. The pink afterimage, whose name is... Alice.
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|6bb: It's an illustrated guide called "Sea Monsters."
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|6c0: ~The Fourth Sea Monster: Mermaids~ Mermaids are said to be a woman above and a fish's tail below.
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|6d2: They have beautiful voices that lull listeners to sleep and drag them into the sea. Then they devour their souls.
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|6e2: If you ever see a beautiful woman swimming at sea during a voyage, never call out to her.
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|6ef: If she is a mermaid, you will fall into a deadly sleep without ever learning the truth.
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|708: It's a book called "A Certain Treasure Hunter's Message, Chapter 2."
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|70f: I'm a nameless treasure hunter. Rumor said a ship carrying a rainbow branch sank in the southern sea, so I came to this village.
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|71f: I gave my sea chart to the best fisherman to dredge the seabed, but the net held only tasty scallops.
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|72b: Now I'm at the tavern, having the scallops cooked, chatting with the lovely proprietress and sipping. Delicious.
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|73a: The village's best fisherman has a fiancée, but he doesn't seem keen on it. Is there someone else in his heart?
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|747: Ah, dawn is near. I never found the rainbow branch, but I gained happy hours and a friend. Travel is a fine thing.
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|765: Hold your hand over the great tree's root?
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|76c: You no longer feel any mysterious power from this root.
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|775: The great tree's root simply stretches from the ground. Looking at it seems to do nothing.
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|91d: Miko's memoir lies here. {var:1} read Miko's memoir.
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|97a: You got the ultimate cannon! Give it to the turtle director at the Nautica museum!
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|98c: You got a fragrant perfume! Give it to Colt in front of the headmistress's office at the Medal Academy for Girls!
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|ab0: Here is the spring of recovery. One sip and you'll be full of vigor. A blessed miraculous spring.
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|aca: "I'm Kurutchi's uncle, Ojitchi, tchi. If you want to go to Tickington, talk to me, tchi.
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|b0f: "I'm Kurutchi's uncle, Ojitchi, tchi. If you want to go to Tickington, talk to me, tchi.

id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|ae7: "But if you go to Tickington and meet Kurutchi, you'll remember, tchi.
id./param/region/r005.pack|book_ie.bxon|b1a: "In place of Kurutchi, I'll send the Luminary to Tickington, tchi."

tm.こんな さびれた場所まで来たのに\n何もないと 落ち込んでいる あなた！\nさぞ: Feeling down because you came all this way to such a desolate place and found nothing? You must be exhausted!
tm.そんな時は ぜひ ホムラの温泉へ！\nあなたの疲れ 癒やします\nここより北 ホ: Then come to the Hotto hot springs! We'll soothe your weariness. North of here: Hotto.
tm.ここより北 荒野の地下迷宮\n南へ行くと 関所: North: the wasteland labyrinth. South: the checkpoint.
tm.湯あがりの 彼女のカオも ホムラ色\n霧越しに見る ヒノノギの尾根: Her face flushed red from the bath, like Hotto's glow. The Hinonogi ridge, seen through the mist.
tm.「まあ！ お兄さんったら\n どこから 入ったんですか？\n そちらは女湯ですよ: "Oh my! Sir, how did you get in here? This is the women's bath.
tm.「こんな時でも 当店の決まりは\n 守ってくれないと こまります。\n さあ 早: "Even now, I must ask you to follow our rules. Please leave right away."
tm.「あら お兄さん。\n そちらは 女湯ですよ。: "Oh, sir. This is the women's bath.
tm.「こんな時でも 当店の決まりは\n 守ってくれないと こまります。\n さあ 戻: "Even now, I must ask you to follow our rules. Please go back out."
tm.「悪気は なかったのかもしれませんが\n 当店の決まりは守ってくれないと こまり: "You may have meant no harm, but you must follow our rules. Please leave right away."
tm.約束のベールを かぶった 美しい人魚の絵だ。: A painting of a beautiful mermaid wearing the Promise Veil.
tm.「にぎやかで いいわねぇ～！\n なんだか アタシ いつもより\n お酒が おい: "How lively! Somehow my drink tastes even better than usual~♪
tm.「さっき食べた 手作りスルメも\n と～っても おいしかったわぁ～♪: "And that homemade dried squid I just had was so delicious~♪
tm.「クラーゴン退治に 参加してたってんなら\n キナイのヤツも この村に帰ってきて: "If he joined the Kraken hunt, Kinai must have come back to the village too.
tm.「{var:1} あせることねえよ。\n とりあえず 今は つかの間の休息ってヤ: "{var:1}, no need to rush. For now, it's just a brief rest. Let's take it easy in this village.
tm.「今まで追われてばかり だったからな。\n ここまで 村のみんなから感謝されると: "We've been hunted for so long. Being thanked by everyone in the village like this makes me a little shy. Heh.
tm.「え？ キナイを見つけたって？\n マジか！ やったな！\n 海底に沈んだオーブ: "What? You found Kinai? Really? Great! We're one step closer to the orb sunk on the seabed!
tm.「すぐに 出発といきたいところだが\n この村の食い物は めちゃめちゃウマいから: "I'd like to set out right away, but the food in this village is amazing. Let's stay a little longer.
tm.「漁師の皆さまの 治療をしているのですが\n なんだか おかしいですわ……。\n: "I've been treating the fishermen, but something is strange. The number of injured seems to keep growing.
tm.「キナイさんは まだ一度も いらしてませんし\n どこに いらっしゃるのでしょう: "Kinai hasn't come even once. Where could he be? I hope he isn't hurt.
tm.「先ほど ひとりの漁師さんが\n 思いつめた表情で 教会へ行かれましたわ。: "A fisherman just went to the church with a troubled look on his face.
tm.「……まあ あの方が キナイさんでしたのね。\n でしたら ロミアさんのことを聞: "...Oh, so that was Kinai. But if he heard about Romia, why did he look so gloomy...?
tm.「宴から離れてみれば 静かな海じゃ\n なんとも 心が 落ち着くのお。\n こん: "Away from the feast, the sea is calm. It soothes the heart. On a night like this, I can't help but remember the old days.
tm.「……そんなことより この奥方によれば\n キナイは 港の桟橋にいるようじゃ。\: "...Never mind that. This lady says Kinai is at the harbor pier. You should go see.
tm.「わしは もうすこし\n この奥方と 話がしたいでのお。\n おぬしたちだけで: "I'd like to talk with this lady a little longer. You all go ahead."
tm.「おお {var:1}。\n 先ほど キナイが ここに来たんじゃが。\n 裏口の: "Oh, {var:1}. Kinai was just here. He went out through the back door.
tm.「やけに こわいカオをしておったが\n いったい 何があったというんじゃ？: "He looked quite fearsome. What on earth happened?
tm.「キナイのことを 聞いてまわったけれど\n この酒場には 来ていないみたいね。: "I asked around about Kinai, but he doesn't seem to have come to this tavern.
tm.「ロミアが 白の入り江で待ってるわ。\n 早く キナイを見つけてあげましょう。: "Romia is waiting at White Cove. Let's find Kinai quickly.
tm.聖なる種火が 火山に反応している。\n火口の中に 聖なる種火の炎をくべて\n伝説: The sacred flame is reacting to the volcano. Cast the sacred flame into the crater to raise the legendary forge?
tm.「まあ！ お兄さんったら\n どこから 入ったんですか？\n そちらは 女湯です: "Oh my! Sir, how did you get in here? This is the women's bath.
tm.「女性のお客さまもいるのに こまります。\n さあ 早く 出てくださいな。: "There are women customers here too. Please leave right away."
tm.そまつな石でできた ふるびた墓だ。\n彫られた文字は 消えかけていて\nもう 読: An old grave made of crude stone. The carved letters have faded and can no longer be read.
tm.長いこと 潮風に さらされ\nふるびてしまった墓が 並んでいる。: Graves worn by long years of sea wind stand in a row.
tm.「待って {var:1}。\n キナイの あの様子。ただごとじゃないわ。\n 何: "Wait, {var:1}. Kinai's behavior was not normal. Maybe something important is going on...
tm.「ナギムナー村に 戻る前に\n 彼の話を聞いたほうが いいような気がするの。\n: "Before we return to Lonalulu, I think we should hear him out. Let's follow Kinai."
tm.ヤヤクの手記が 置いてある。\nかなり 長い内容のようだが\n読んでみますか？: Miko's memoir lies here. It seems quite long. Read it?
tm.時折 無性に 大声で叫びたくなる。\nおのれの罪を 決して忘れぬよう\nこの手記: At times I feel a desperate urge to scream. So that I never forget my sin, I shall write the truth in this memoir...
tm.……激闘の末 私とハリマは\n人食い火竜を退治した。\nハリマの一太刀が とどめ: ...After a fierce battle, Ryu and I slew the man-eating fire dragon. Ryu's blow was the finishing stroke.
tm.だが その刹那…… 火竜は\n断末魔のごとく 黒い瘴気を噴き上げ\nハリマは そ: But in that instant, the dragon belched black miasma like a death cry, and Ryu was caught in it.
tm.倒れた ハリマを連れ 里に戻り\n私は 必死に あの子を看病したが……。: I carried the fallen Ryu back to the village and nursed him desperately, but...
tm.あの瘴気は 火竜の呪いだったのだ。\nハリマの姿は だんだんと 火竜に近づき\n: That miasma was the dragon's curse. Ryu slowly grew dragon-like, until the village could no longer hide it.
tm.里の者に知られたら 殺されてしまう……。\n私は ハリマを 火竜との戦いで\n死: If the villagers found out, they would kill him... I declared that Ryu had died fighting the dragon, and hid him in the volcano.
tm.私は ハリマを元の姿に戻す方法を\n死に物狂いで探した。\nそして ついに 見つ: I searched frantically for a way to restore Ryu. And at last, I found it.
tm.真実の姿を うつすという やたの鏡……。\nこれで ハリマも 元の姿に戻れるはず: The Yata mirror, said to reveal one's true form... With this, Ryu should return to his old self.
tm.しかし いくら火竜をうつしても 鏡は反応せず。\n真の使い方が わかる その日ま: Shown a dragon, the mirror never reacted. Until I learn its true use, I will keep it on me always.
tm.だが 時は 待ってはくれぬ。\nハリマが 人の血肉を欲するようになり\n里から: But time would not wait. Ryu began to crave human flesh, and the village had no choice but to offer sacrifices.
tm.いけにえを出すこと……悩み 苦しんだが\nどうしても 私は かわいい息子 ハリマ: Giving sacrifices... I agonized and suffered, but I simply cannot let my beloved son Ryu die.
tm.やたの鏡の使い方さえ わかれば\nハリマを救うことができる……。: If only I could learn how to use the Yata mirror, I could save Ryu...
tm.ハリマを生かすためならば\nこの修羅の道 歩いてみせよう。\nたとえ どんな罰を: To keep Ryu alive, I will walk this path of carnage. Whatever punishment awaits me...!
tm.いにしえの巫女が 書いたらしき\n古い日記のようだ。: It seems to be an old diary written by an ancient shrine maiden.
tm.しかし 今の {var:1}には\n関係なさそうな内容だ。: But the contents seem unrelated to {var:1}.
tm.ホムラの隆盛 我が代にて きわまれり。\nみつぎ物 つきることなく 金銀財宝\n: Hotto prospers as never before in my reign. Tribute never ends; gold, silver and jewels overflow.
tm.我が宮の倉 すでに 財を収めきれず\n倉より 光あふれ出て 夜空を照らすほど。\: My storehouse can hold no more wealth; its light fills the night sky. I order the villagers to move the treasure.
tm.財を納めし箱 緋色の秘石と共に\nヒノノギの火山の 裏道より入りて\n火の神を見: The treasure box and scarlet gem lie past Mount Huji's back path, overlooking the god of fire.
tm.～第１章 夢のはじまり～\n俺は 鍛冶職人のイッテツ ４８歳。\n好きな食べ物は: ~Chapter 1: The Dream Begins~ I'm Ittetsu, a blacksmith, age 48. My favorite food is horse mackerel namerou.
tm.今日 里の風呂屋で すごいものを拾った。\n一見すると なんの変哲もない金貨だが: Today I found something amazing at the bathhouse. A plain gold coin, but its fine star design is no ordinary work.
tm.俺の中の鍛冶職人魂は ふるえ\nもう いてもたっても いられなかった。\n聞けば: My blacksmith's soul trembled; I couldn't sit still. I hear it's called a mini medal.
tm.俺は 生まれ育った故郷を離れ\nちいさなメダルを作る方法を 学ぶため\n旅にでる: I've decided to leave my hometown and set out on a journey to learn how to make mini medals.
tm.ああ 止めてくれるな おっかさん。\n世界一の鍛冶職人になって\nまた この里へ: Oh, don't stop me, Mother. I'll become the world's best blacksmith and return to this village someday...
tm.『ヤヤクとハリマのぼうけん』という絵本だ。: It's a picture book called "The Adventures of Miko and Ryu."
tm.ホムラの里をおさめる ヤヤクとハリマ。\nふたりは親子であり 魔物も にげだすほ: Miko and Ryu ruled Hotto. They were father and son, and so strong that monsters fled from them.
tm.ホムラの里を おさめる ふたりは\n外から やってくる魔物を 退治して\n里の人: The two who ruled Hotto defeated the monsters that came from outside and protected the villagers.
tm.そんな ふたりには 宿命の相手がいました。\n大昔から ヒノノギ火山を ねぐらに: But the two had a fated enemy: a man-eating fire dragon that had long lived on Mount Huji and attacked Hotto.
tm.ある日 長い戦いのはてに\nふたりは 人食い火竜を うちたおしました。\nしかし: One day, after a long battle, the two defeated the man-eating fire dragon. But then Ryu was struck by the dragon's fang...
tm.ハリマは そのまま かえらぬ人となりましたが\nその なまえは 今も\nホムラの: Ryu never returned, but his name is still told in Hotto to this day.
tm.『ピンク色の残像 ～アリス伝説の証明～』\nという伝記だ。: It's a biography called "Pink Afterimage: Proving the Legend of Alice."
tm.まずしい農家の出身で ありながら\nその人柄と ウデっぷしだけで\nバンデルフォ: Born to a poor farming family, through character and strength alone, they rose to naval officer of the Bandelfon Kingdom...
tm.敬愛する 国王の死と共に\n海賊に転身した 愛と正義のピンクマスクは\nある日: With their beloved king dead, they turned pirate. Love and Justice's Pink Mask thrilled the world.
tm.友人の旅芸人と 共に あまたの軍艦\n商船 貨物船のマストを ピンク色に染めあげ: With a traveling entertainer, they dyed the masts of countless ships pink, in mourning for the king.
tm.あの ピンク色に染まった海は\n今もなお 私たちの心に 焼きついて離れない\nピ: That pink-dyed sea still burns in our hearts today. The pink afterimage, whose name is... Alice.
tm.『海の怪物たち』という図鑑だ。: It's an illustrated guide called "Sea Monsters."
tm.～第４の海の怪物 人魚～\n人魚の姿は 一般的に 上半身が人間の女性\n下半身は: ~The Fourth Sea Monster: Mermaids~ Mermaids are said to be a woman above and a fish's tail below.
tm.美しい歌声を持ち その声を聞いた人々を\n眠らせて 海へ引きずり込む。\nそして: They have beautiful voices that lull listeners to sleep and drag them into the sea. Then they devour their souls.
tm.もしも あなたが 航海の途中で\n海を泳ぐ 美しい女性を見かけても\n決して 声: If you ever see a beautiful woman swimming at sea during a voyage, never call out to her.
tm.その女性が 人魚だったなら\nあなたは その真実を知ることもなく\n死の眠りに: If she is a mermaid, you will fall into a deadly sleep without ever learning the truth.
tm.『とあるトレジャーハンターの伝言 第２章』\nという本だ。: It's a book called "A Certain Treasure Hunter's Message, Chapter 2."
tm.私は ナナシのトレジャーハンター。\n虹色の枝を乗せた船が 南国の海で沈んだとい: I'm a nameless treasure hunter. Rumor said a ship carrying a rainbow branch sank in the southern sea, so I came to this village.
tm.村いちばんの漁師に 海図を渡す代わりに\n海の底をさらってもらったが アミにかか: I gave my sea chart to the best fisherman to dredge the seabed, but the net held only tasty scallops.
tm.今は 村の酒場で ホタテを調理してもらって\n美人な若女将と おしゃべりしながら: Now I'm at the tavern, having the scallops cooked, chatting with the lovely proprietress and sipping. Delicious.
tm.村いちばんの漁師は 許嫁がいるそうだが\nあまり 乗り気じゃないみたいだ。\n心: The village's best fisherman has a fiancée, but he doesn't seem keen on it. Is there someone else in his heart?
tm.ああ もうすぐ 夜が明ける。\n虹色の枝は 見つからなかったが\n楽しい時間と: Ah, dawn is near. I never found the rainbow branch, but I gained happy hours and a friend. Travel is a fine thing.
tm.大樹の根に 手をかざしますか？: Hold your hand over the great tree's root?
tm.この根からは もう\n不思議なチカラを 感じない。: You no longer feel any mysterious power from this root.
tm.大樹の根は ただ静かに 地面から伸びている。\nどうやら 調べても 何も起こらな: The great tree's root simply stretches from the ground. Looking at it seems to do nothing.
tm.ヤヤクの手記が 置いてある。\n{var:1}は ヤヤクの手記を読んだ。: Miko's memoir lies here. {var:1} read Miko's memoir.
tm.とびっきりの大砲を手に入れた！\n海底王国ムウレアの 博物館にいる\nウミガメの: You got the ultimate cannon! Give it to the turtle director at the Nautica museum!
tm.かぐわしい香水を 手に入れた！\nメダル女学園の校長室前にいる\nコルトに 渡し: You got a fragrant perfume! Give it to Colt in front of the headmistress's office at the Medal Academy for Girls!
tm.ここに 見えるは 回復の泉\nひとくち飲めば たちまち 元気みなぎる\nありがた: Here is the spring of recovery. One sip and you'll be full of vigor. A blessed miraculous spring.
tm.「ワシは クルッチの叔父の オジッチだッチ。\n ヨッチ村に 行きたい時は\n: "I'm Kurutchi's uncle, Ojitchi, tchi. If you want to go to Tickington, talk to me, tchi.
tm.「ワシら ヨッチ族のことを 忘れてしまうとは\n 勇者さまは 意外と 忘れっぽい: "Forgetting us Tockle folk... the Luminary is rather forgetful, tchi.
tm.「でも ヨッチ村に行って クルッチに会えば\n きっと 思いだすッチ。: "But if you go to Tickington and meet Kurutchi, you'll remember, tchi.
tm.「クルッチの代わりに ワシが\n 勇者さまを ヨッチ村まで送るッチ。: "In place of Kurutchi, I'll send the Luminary to Tickington, tchi."
